usedFor: MarketProvider holds products and Microsoft Excel holds your sheet, so “New Product Created” can run “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Created” in MarketProvider, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new product adds a row to an Excel table, so your product list stays current.

watchOut: “Product Is Updated” in MarketProvider also reaches “Add Row To Table”, so edits could add duplicate rows without “Update Row”.
